## Verification

- [ ] Branch name follows `feature/`, `fix/`, or another documented topic prefix
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm run check`
- [ ] `pnpm run build`
- [ ] Tests were added or updated when behavior changed
- [ ] Tested unpacked in Firefox and/or Chrome when relevant
- [ ] No credentials, cookies, tokens, profile data, or generated packages were committed
- [ ] A release-note label was applied (`feature`, `fix`, `security`, `dependencies`, `documentation`, or `skip-changelog`)
